relevant_laws.quote: It is unlawful for any person to drive or operate a vehicle of any kind or character at: A rate of speed greater than is reasonable or proper, having due regard for the traffic, surface and width of the highway, the weather and other highway conditions.

activation_conditions: the subject drives or operates a vehicle of any kind
residue: tier S: 'reasonable or proper' is the whole obligation. Any rule is a surrogate whose bounds come from a stopping- or sight-distance model, declared as an operationalization claim
reason.subject: driver

timing_requirements.requirement: the basic speed rule binds at every instant; the conditions it is judged against change frame by frame
